flags.message: The supplied decided snapshot dates the petition entry September 6, 2025, but DocketedDate is July 21, 2026, the event opens July 21, 2026, and petition/appendix link filenames and the response schedule point to 2026. claude-baseline and codex-baseline also identified this inconsistency in their staged rationales.
